facts.fact: Ares 自陈没有内在道德罗盘，只遵守他认为合乎逻辑的规则，包括同意与安全程序；他把道德称为表演
facts.anchor: My friends think I have a moral compass. But I don’t have morality; I have rules.

facts.fact: Ares 从吧台后监控看 Kayla 过桥，没有像大多数人那样在门口踌躇，还留意了出口
facts.anchor: Kayla didn’t hesitate, instinctively deciding she wanted to be here.

facts.fact: Vero 向 Kayla 解释腕带颜色标明追猎者、级别及同意范围，Ares 设计了大部分系统
facts.anchor: The color of your wristband tells the staff who you belong to.

facts.fact: Clay 质问 Kayla 为何在岛上，她回答自己是被邀请的，Vero 认领邀请
facts.anchor: “I was invited,” Kayla answers flatly before Vero or I can answer.

facts.fact: Kayla 反击 Clay 的「我的岛」言辞，指出他只是员工，刺中他的自尊
facts.anchor: “So what you meant to say is, it’s not your island. You work here . . . you’re just staff.”

facts.fact: Clay 逼近 Kayla 时 Vero 想插手，Ares 拦住他，事后解释她不需要援手
facts.anchor: “Because she didn’t need you to interfere.”

facts.fact: Vero 在墓园向 Kayla 明说自己与 Brawley 不可分割，Kayla 表示不会介入两人的关系
facts.anchor: “Brawley and I are a package deal.”

facts.fact: Kayla 对 Vero 的加入问题回答 In，随后转问 Ares，Ares 也回答 In；这并非夜猎合同已签
facts.anchor: Kayla holds his gaze and smiles. “In.”
